realme-desc: Waxay u oggolaanaysaa xaqiijinta URLs-ka lagu isticmaalo bogagga isticmaalaha.
realme-preference-error-not-http: URL-ka $1 waa inuu isticmaalaa http:// ama https:// halkii uu ka isticmaali lahaa $2.
realme-preference-error-too-many: Waxaad cayimi kartaa oo keliya {{PLURAL:$1|hal URL|$1 URL-yada}}.
realme-preference-help: Fadlan ku dar hal URL safkiiba. Marka URL-yadan lagu isticmaalo bogga isticmaalaha, waxaa lagu dari doonaa calaamadaha <link rel="me"> ee [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HTML_element HTML], kuwaas oo qaar ka mid ah goobaha (tusaale Mastodon) ay u isticmaalaan inay ku calaamadeeyaan isku xirka profile-ka inuu yahay la xaqiijiyey. Wixii faahfaahin dheeraad ah, eeg [https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Help:Extension:RealMe bogga caawinta] ee MediaWiki.org.
realme-config-error-canonical: Cinwaannada bogagga waa in lagu qeexaa qaabkooda saxda ah, isticmaal $1 halkii aad ka isticmaali lahayd $2.
realme-config-error-invalidtitle: $1 ma aha cinwaan bog oo sax ah.
